reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) shows W addition improves high-temperature wear resistance in AlCoCrFeNi coatings via lattice distortion and W-rich phases, but it does not demonstrate oxide glaze formation, low-temperature benefit, or applicability to the CoCrFeNi matrix without Al. E1 concerns Nb and WC, not W, and is irrelevant. Thus, key premises about glaze formation and full temperature range performance are unsupported.
premises: W addition to CoCrFeNi induces strong lattice distortion
W addition nucleates W-rich intermetallic/secondary phases
These W-rich phases catalyze formation of a continuous protective oxide glaze during sliding
The glaze layer reduces friction and wear from RT to 800 °C
The mechanism is effective under dry sliding, moderate loads/speeds
